chapter: Wider talk: bands, places and players
title: Don Albert dismissed
summary: He gives his poor opinion of Don Albert's playing.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Did you know Don Albert ever? Yeah. Don Albert. He used to have a band around San Antonio. No, I didn't know nothing about him.
I think he was corny. Yeah. I mean, uh.
As far as I'm concerned, uh, he played the, he couldn't even play a horn as far as I'm concerned. No. And his style was, was pretty bad as far as I'm concerned. That's, that's my opinion. Yeah.
I just wanted, cause he had, you know, there was a lot of territory bands. He sounded more like Ellington to me than any else.
Well, I don't know what the hell he sounded like, but the, that style, that style and the sound to me, I, I stayed away from. You know, that's my personal opinion. Yeah.
